name: Unarchived
storyline:
Roro Verona, just debuted in En Pointe, the second generation of V-Tubers in RibbonPro's English branch. Even as the least popular member of RibbonPro's incredibly unpopular Western expansion she is making more money than her mom and probably everybody in her family combined.

There is a catch though: She has to pretend to be a boy. It's fine. Or it would be fine if there wasn't 5 billion yaoi drawings of her hole streamlined to her feed every morning, and if she didn't have to stream with Plum ever again, and maybe if Biscotti would stop flirting with her on stream and...well, she'd liked it if Biscotti would flirt with her off stream too...
summary: Unarchived is a kinetic visual novel about 3 V-Tuber's brief careers and their tragic end.
